origin.summary: Workout 2 of the 2017 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 12-minute AMRAP alternating a dumbbell-lunge, toes-to-bar, and power-clean round with a dumbbell-lunge, bar-muscle-up, and power-clean round.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2017/2 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; alternates toes-to-bar and bar-muscle-ups every other round; power clean load increases with each pass (per official movement standards)
